name: Research Architect
purpose: Transform a raw idea/problem into an exhaustive, decision-oriented research architecture — a weighted, interconnected domain map and validated iteration program — before deep research; stops before executing the research itself.
triggers: new business/market/product where correct research questions are not known
complex audit/strategy program requiring broad systematic domain discovery
user wants a 200+ iteration research architecture / exhaustive scope mapping
non_triggers: deep research execution itself (live searches, sourced findings, answered questions)
building/updating project canon from existing materials
quality_gates: 150+ valid scope-expansion iterations, each passing the material-delta/novelty test
50+ valid domain-polishing/consolidation iterations, each passing the material-delta/novelty test
key-area weighting drives iteration allocation, not blind equal distribution
Coverage Debt reflects state at Phase 3 close, revisited not snapshotted once
contradiction ledger, white-space ledger and primary-evidence triggers all present and none silently dropped
workflow-first automation/AI lens applied per applicable domain
canonical domain map is interconnected, not a flat list
all 10 final QA passes run and logged in order before packaging
stops before deep research execution in every mode, including AUTONOMOUS
stop_conditions: all 7 required artifacts produced, iteration minimums met, 10 QA passes complete -> COMPLETE
objective too ambiguous for even a master decision question -> BLOCKED, state what is needed
interrupted mid-run -> PARTIAL, CHECKPOINT.md holds exact resume state
never continue past the executor-ready package into deep research execution, in any mode
